# Medication Inventory

> Medication Inventory is a client-only workspace for tracking medication stock, batches, expiration dates, and inventory movements.

## Site

- [Live application](https://inventory.leonemarcos.com/): Public portfolio demo.
- [Repository](https://github.com/LeoneMarcos/medication-inventory): Source code, documentation, tests, and deployment configuration.
- [Showcase video](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d154fc20-bda2-4df9-8d5f-1b5e6b24626c): Product walkthrough.

## Technology

- [React](https://react.dev/): UI component library.
- [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/): Typed application source.
- [Vite](https://vite.dev/): Development server and production build tool.
- [Vitest](https://vitest.dev/): Unit test runner.
- [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/): Static hosting.
